title: Scan aware libraries table
summary: Added a backend-authored Libraries summary route and WebView table that shows saved LibraryProfiles with queue source scan media/sidecar counts, scan status, and last scan evidence.
reason: The existing Library Profile editor can save multiple libraries, but the UI did not make saved libraries or scan evidence visible at a glance.
behavior_before: Libraries were primarily represented as editor tabs/cards; queue source scan evidence did not expose per-library sidecar aggregates in the Libraries page.
behavior_after: The Libraries page shows a saved-library summary table above the editor, backed by GET /api/libraries/summary, and queue source scan artifacts include sidecar aggregate counts without adding sidecars to launchable queue rows.
manual_validation: feature implementation complete; strict worktree coverage remains blocked only by unrelated path-picker files listed in validation evidence
